config.notes: International view (5 Oct, Platform Admin 13:02): every La Trobe page is read through Firecrawl at www.latrobe.edu.au/courses/<slug>#/fees?studentType=int&year=2027 (page_view render, wait 4 s). No location parameter: the page shows the international annual fee, 2027 start dates and Learning mode for its default campus without it (tested 5 Oct on Master of Dietetics and Associate Degree in Engineering Technology: CRICOS code matched, Semester 1 (March 2027), Semester 2 (July 2027), fee A$ per 120 credit points, Multi-Modal); a fixed location=BU would show "not available" for courses taught only at Sydney, Bendigo or other campuses. Courses previously bound to handbook.latrobe.edu.au (no fees, start dates or delivery) were rebound by hand to their own course page where one exists. Page text: "Indicative course information for international students ... CRICOS code <code> Start dates Semester 1 (March 2027), Semester 2 (July 2027) Duration ... Learning mode ... Annual tuition fee A$45 600 per 120 credit points (120 credit points = one full-time year) ... English language requirement 6.5 IELTS (Academic) with no individual band less than 6.0". Intakes = months in brackets after Start dates; fee = international annual tuition fee per 120 credit points (one full-time year); the fee pattern also takes the first start date before it so the fee year (2027) is recorded; IELTS = overall score; mode = Learning mode. Research degrees print no start dates or fee. Short courses (graduate certificates) print "Annual tuition fee A$20 700 full course duration (per 60 credit points)" - a whole-course amount, NOT read as the annual fee (the pattern needs "per" straight after the amount). not_admitting flags "not available to international students at the <campus> campus in <year>" (the default campus is not offered to international students). Handbook pages (handbook.latrobe.edu.au/courses/<year>/<code>, still bound for courses with no current course page) carry Location(s), CRICOS code, duration, study level and AQF level only. Intakes also read from dated start dates ("Start dates 1 February 2027"). Research degrees print "Start dates Anytime (2027)" (no month, no intakes) and "Annual tuition fee A$43 800 per EFTSL" (one full-time year, read as the annual fee). Exit awards (Platform Admin 15:22): the course page (international view, outcomes block is in the stored text) lists "Year N After completing N year(s) of full-time study You can exit with a/an <Award>"; exit_awards captures each sentence up to the next "Year N", an " or " second award, or the course title before "intended learning outcomes". Where two awards are offered ("Diploma of Arts or Diploma in Business") only the first is captured. Entry requirement (Platform Admin 15:36): "Entry requirements and pathways International students Academic entry requirement Prerequisites <text>"; entry_requirement takes the text after it up to the first full stop (max 200 characters), shown for review only. Undergraduate pages print "Subject prerequisites <VCE Units 3 and 4 ...>" instead; that is read too.
